question: The compiled layer's one positive independent result is the AlphaGenome deletion feature on the held-out ENCODE CRISPRi element-gene pairs in K562 (+0.1361 [95% CI 0.0749, 0.2258] on 1,918 pairs, crispri_published_v2.json, arm 1). Followed through each stage of the compiled layer - the target the compiled programme names, the value it states, the strength the bridge fits in K562, the reader gate in K562, the regulator assignment in K562 and the run's predicted change in K562 - at which stage does the agreement with the measured CRISPRi outcome stop being detectable over activity and distance?

limitations: the metric ranks all 1,918 pairs; a stage that keeps few of them can move the ranking of those few only, so a loss at such a stage says that the stage's predictions reach too few of the measured pairs, as much as anything about the values it carries. The kept counts stand beside every reading for that reason

a K562 reader state is ENCODE DNase-seq peak overlap and a regulator is ENCODE TF ChIP-seq occupancy: accessibility and occupancy, not function. AlphaGenome was trained on ENCODE, so neither is independent of the deletion feature

the held-out file's positives were filtered on chromatin at the tested element (crispri.POSITIVE_FILTER, found post hoc on 2026-09-27) and the activity column reads H3K27ac from the same file; every stage shares that baseline, so it cancels from the stage-to-stage comparisons and not from a gain over activity and distance
the bridge's rates are mouse NIH 3T3 or their genome median; the predicted change does not depend on them (runrules.READING), and no level in molecules per cell is quoted
no stage is a test of a mechanism: a stage that carries the signal says only that the compiled layer, at that stage, still ranks the measured pairs better than activity and distance do

promotion.defect_reported_beside_the_readings: the registered run read its own registration (data/results/signaltrace_registration.json) and did not declare it among its inputs, so save_result quarantined the complete payload; the payload is written here unchanged with the registration (and the quarantined file read to promote it) declared. No computed field was changed and the run was not repeated (scripts/signaltrace_promote.py)

exclusions: every stage after the anchor reads the compiled programs with their experimental rule lines removed. Those rules carry the CRISPRi screens' own EffectSize, the held-out file's pairs included (marked 'held-out split, evaluation only, never a feature'), and the bridge prefers an experimental rule to a predicted one for the same mechanism (bridge.PRECEDENCE), so a stage that read them would read the outcome. The removed lines are counted per program and must equal readergate.rule_targets' count of experimental rule lines; nothing else in a program is changed
held-out pairs in cell types other than K562: the anchor is a K562 result
a pair a stage drops is kept in the population with 0 in that stage's two columns
